title: Your Brain: Who's in Control? | Full Documentary | NOVA | PBS
summary: A NOVA documentary with neuroscientist Heather Berlin exploring the subconscious and what drives our decisions. It uses sleepwalking, anesthesia, improvised rap in an MRI and game theory to probe how much of the brain's work is hidden.
why: Recommended in threads on consciousness, anesthesia and perception as a fascinating look at how much of experience the brain constructs.

quote.text: Both of these videos are great resources on how much of what you experience of reality is made up or filled in by your brain
